comparison.objective: Select, mount, lock, and set a camera zoom lens versus commission an industrial-axis damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Overhead lens alignment, insertion, mount locking, and zoom-ring setting versus hex-key setscrew work, collar adjustment, counterholding, and impact-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Correct lens remains mounted nose-down at 50 mm versus two safe repeatable stops with no bottoming or setting drift.
comparison.reason: Fine rotation and locking are shared generic primitives, but the objective and tested dynamic ability differ. The record omits numeric mount and focal-setting tolerances.
